posts.title: Welcome to the Manchester United Dashboard
posts.excerpt: Welcome to the new Manchester United dashboard.
posts.content: This dashboard brings together fixtures, results, players, league table information and Manchester United blog content in one application.

posts.title: The Importance of Squad Depth
posts.excerpt: Why having a strong squad matters over a long Premier League season.
posts.content: A Premier League season is a long campaign and squad depth can play a huge role in maintaining performance throughout the season.
